links.outcome: Calibration error (ECE) of patient-level predictions before and after local recalibration
links.effect: Patient-level predictions were substantially miscalibrated (In Hospital Mortality ECE 0.286). Two-parameter recalibration using 50 to 200 labeled examples reduced ECE to 0.007.
links.quote: We introduce a lightweight, two parameter recalibration method that adapts predictions to local patient populations using 50 to 200 labeled examples, reducing ECE to 0.007.

screen.reason: Evaluates a zero-shot model (MedJev) on medical question answering and clinical prediction tasks, and directly tests a lightweight local recalibration method to address poor calibration on patient-level tasks.
